# never edit by hand. `C<TAB>case<TAB>checked-cells` lists every case; `F<TAB>case<TAB>item` lists
# every bit-level known failure, `E<TAB>case<TAB>item` those of them outside decision 0355's
# envelope (a wrong type, error or text, a number off both 12 digits of Excel and the math, or a
# whole case: `*`, `!status`), and `W<TAB>case<TAB>item` those of the E items that are a wrong
# type, error or text, or a whole case. Removing an F line = a fix. In an unchanged case a new E
# or W line = a regression and requires --allow-regressions plus a justification in the PR, while
# a new F line without an E line is drift, recorded without it (docs/process/quality-gates.md).
# `TC` and `TF` lines gate displayed text exactly (decision 0070).
